text: Actions are judged by intentions, and every person will be rewarded according to what they intended.
None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
The strong person is not the one who overcomes people through strength, but the one who controls himself while in anger.
Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or remain silent.
The best among you are those who have the best manners and character.
Whoever removes a hardship from a believer in this world, Allah will remove from him one of the hardships of the Day of Judgment.
The believers who show the most perfect faith are those with the best character, and the best of you are those who are best to their wives.
Smiling at your brother is charity.
He is not a believer whose stomach is filled while his neighbor beside him is hungry.
Seeking knowledge is an obligation upon every Muslim.
Whoever travels a path in search of knowledge, Allah will make easy for him a path to Paradise.
The most beloved of deeds to Allah are those done consistently, even if small.
Richness is not having many possessions; rather, true richness is the richness of the soul.
A good word is charity.
Whoever guides someone to good will have a reward like the one who does it.
The example of the believers in their affection, mercy and compassion for each other is that of a body: when a limb aches, the whole body reacts with fever and sleeplessness.
None of you truly believes until his desires are subject to what I have brought.
Be mindful of Allah, and He will protect you. Be mindful of Allah, and you will find Him in front of you.
Fear Allah wherever you are, follow a bad deed with a good one to erase it, and behave well towards people.
narrator: Abu Dharr and Mu'adh ibn Jabal

text: Leave what makes you doubt for what does not make you doubt.
None of you truly believes until he wishes for his neighbor what he wishes for himself.
Modesty is a branch of faith.
The most perfect of believers in faith are those best in character, and the best of you are those who are best to their families.
Whoever does not show mercy to people, Allah will not show mercy to him.
Paradise lies at the feet of your mother.
The upper hand is better than the lower hand. The upper hand is the one that gives, and the lower hand is the one that takes.
None of you truly believes until I am more beloved to him than his father, his child, and all of humankind.
A Muslim is one from whose tongue and hand other Muslims are safe.
Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should honor his guest.
Religion is sincerity, sincerity to Allah, His Book, His Messenger, and to the leaders of the Muslims and their common folk.
